!138 = !{!"repro.hlsl", !"#include \22ShaderShared.h\22\0D\0A\0D\0AGlobalRootSignature DefaultRT_GlobalRootSignature =\0D\0A{\0D\0A    \22RootFlags(0),\22\0D\0A    \22DescriptorTable( UAV( u0 ), SRV( t0 ), CBV( b0 ) )\22   // g_rtOutput, g_tlas, g_sceneCB\0D\0A};\0D\0A\0D\0ALocalRootSignature DefaultRT_LocalRootSignature =\0D\0A{\0D\0A    \22DescriptorTable( SRV( t1, numDescriptors = 2 ) ),\22    // g_indices, g_vertices\0D\0A    \22RootConstants( num32BitConstants = 4, b1 )\22           // g_materialCB (inlined)\0D\0A};\0D\0A\0D\0ATriangleHitGroup DefaultRT_HitGroup =\0D\0A{\0D\0A    \22\22,                             // AnyHit\0D\0A    \22DefaultRT_ClosestHitShader\22    // ClosestHit\0D\0A};\0D\0A\0D\0ARaytracingShaderConfig  DefaultRT_ShaderConfig =\0D\0A{\0D\0A    16,                             // Max payload size (sizeof(RayPayload))\0D\0A    8                               // Max attribute size (sizeof(BuiltInTriangleIntersectionAttributes))\0D\0A};\0D\0A\0D\0ARaytracingPipelineConfig DefaultRT_PipelineConfig =\0D\0A{\0D\0A    1                               // Max trace recursion depth\0D\0A};\0D\0A\0D\0A// Global root signature resources:\0D\0ARWTexture2D<float4> g_rtOutput : register(u0);\0D\0ARaytracingAccelerationStructure g_tlas : register(t0);\0D\0AConstantBuffer<SceneConstants> g_sceneCB : register(b0);\0D\0A\0D\0A// Local root signature resources:\0D\0AByteAddressBuffer g_indices : register(t1);\0D\0AStructuredBuffer<Vertex> g_vertices : register(t2);\0D\0AConstantBuffer<MaterialConstants> g_materialCB : register(b1);\0D\0A\0D\0Astruct RayPayload\0D\0A{\0D\0A    float4 color;\0D\0A};\0D\0A\0D\0A// Retrieve hit world position.\0D\0Afloat3 HitWorldPosition()\0D\0A{\0D\0A    return WorldRayOrigin() + RayTCurrent() * WorldRayDirection();\0D\0A}\0D\0A\0D\0A// Retrieve attribute at a hit position interpolated from vertex attributes using the hit's barycentrics.\0D\0Afloat3 HitAttribute(float3 vertexAttribute[3], BuiltInTriangleIntersectionAttributes attr)\0D\0A{\0D\0A    return vertexAttribute[0] +\0D\0A        attr.barycentrics.x * (vertexAttribute[1] - vertexAttribute[0]) +\0D\0A        attr.barycentrics.y * (vertexAttribute[2] - vertexAttribute[0]);\0D\0A}\0D\0A\0D\0A// Generate a ray in world space for a camera pixel corresponding to an index from the dispatched 2D grid.\0D\0Ainline void GenerateCameraRay(uint2 index, out float3 origin, out float3 direction)\0D\0A{\0D\0A    float2 xy = index + 0.5f; // center in the middle of the pixel.\0D\0A    float2 screenPos = xy / DispatchRaysDimensions().xy * 2.0 - 1.0;\0D\0A\0D\0A    // Invert Y for DirectX-style coordinates.\0D\0A    screenPos.y = -screenPos.y;\0D\0A\0D\0A    // Unproject the pixel coordinate into a ray.\0D\0A    float4 world = mul(float4(screenPos, 0, 1), g_sceneCB.projectionViewWorld);\0D\0A\0D\0A    world.xyz /= world.w;\0D\0A    origin = g_sceneCB.cameraWorldPos;\0D\0A    direction = normalize(world.xyz - origin);\0D\0A}\0D\0A\0D\0A// Diffuse lighting calculation.\0D\0Afloat4 CalculateDiffuseLighting(float3 hitPosition, float3 normal)\0D\0A{\0D\0A    float3 pixelToLight = normalize(g_sceneCB.lightWorldPos - hitPosition);\0D\0A\0D\0A    // Diffuse contribution.\0D\0A    float nDotL = max(0.0f, dot(pixelToLight, normal));\0D\0A\0D\0A    return g_materialCB.albedo * g_sceneCB.lightDiffuseColor * nDotL;\0D\0A}\0D\0A\0D\0A[shader(\22raygeneration\22)]\0D\0Avoid DefaultRT_RayGenShader()\0D\0A{\0D\0A    float3 rayDir;\0D\0A    float3 origin;\0D\0A\0D\0A    // Generate a ray for a camera pixel corresponding to an index from the dispatched 2D grid.\0D\0A    GenerateCameraRay(DispatchRaysIndex().xy, origin, rayDir);\0D\0A\0D\0A    // Trace the ray.\0D\0A    // Set the ray's extents.\0D\0A    RayDesc ray;\0D\0A    ray.Origin = origin;\0D\0A    ray.Direction = rayDir;\0D\0A    // Set TMin to a non-zero small value to avoid aliasing issues due to floating - point errors.\0D\0A    // TMin should be kept small to prevent missing geometry at close contact areas.\0D\0A    ray.TMin = 0.001;\0D\0A    ray.TMax = g_sceneCB.rayMaxLength;\0D\0A    RayPayload payload = { float4(0, 0, 0, 0) };\0D\0A    TraceRay(g_tlas, RAY_FLAG_CULL_BACK_FACING_TRIANGLES, ~0, 0, 1, 0, ray, payload);\0D\0A\0D\0A    // Write the raytraced color to the output texture.\0D\0A    g_rtOutput[DispatchRaysIndex().xy] = payload.color;\0D\0A}\0D\0A\0D\0A[shader(\22closesthit\22)]\0D\0Avoid DefaultRT_ClosestHitShader(inout RayPayload payload, in BuiltInTriangleIntersectionAttributes attr)\0D\0A{\0D\0A    float3 hitPosition = HitWorldPosition();\0D\0A\0D\0A    // Load index buffer\0D\0A    uint indexOffset = PrimitiveIndex() * 3 /* indices per primitive */ * 4 /* 4 bytes per index*/;\0D\0A    const uint3 indices = g_indices.Load3(indexOffset);\0D\0A\0D\0A    // Retrieve corresponding vertex normals for the triangle vertices.\0D\0A    float3 vertexNormals[3] = { g_vertices[indices[0]].normal, g_vertices[indices[1]].normal, g_vertices[indices[3]].normal };\0D\0A    //                                                                                                           ^\0D\0A    //                                                                                                           |\0D\0A    // THIS SHOULD LEAD TO A COMPILER WARNING AT LEAST -----------------------------------------------------------\0D\0A\0D\0A    // Compute the triangle's interpolated normal\0D\0A    float3 triangleNormal = HitAttribute(vertexNormals, attr);\0D\0A\0D\0A    float4 diffuseColor = CalculateDiffuseLighting(hitPosition, triangleNormal);\0D\0A    float4 color = g_sceneCB.lightAmbientColor + diffuseColor;\0D\0A\0D\0A    payload.color = color;\0D\0A}\0D\0A\0D\0A[shader(\22miss\22)]\0D\0Avoid DefaultRT_MissShader(inout RayPayload payload)\0D\0A{\0D\0A    float4 background = float4(0.0f, 0.2f, 0.4f, 1.0f);\0D\0A    payload.color =
